changes.title: Item history reliability
changes.text: Item-history readers now exclude self-ancestry in cyclic records and retain items mentioned only in later lifecycle events.

changes.title: Metamorphosis announcement
changes.text: Added a short News announcement explaining the already-available five-class talent chooser.

changes.title: Item history and News checks
changes.text: Added cyclic and sparse item-history regressions and kept News popup coverage aligned with every published article.

changes.title: Verification and delivery records
changes.text: Recorded verified TEST108 delivery and the next reader-reliability checks without changing player data.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I strengthened item-history readers for inconsistent records and added a short announcement for the verified metamorphosis chooser. Gameplay, inventory capacity and existing player data are unchanged.
